translation:
In the conditions of injury, if there is vexation and agitation with a red face, dry mouth, and thirst, and the pulse is large and surging yet on pressure is as if absent, one should use Dang Gui Blood-Supplementing Decoction (當歸補血湯). If there is vexation and agitation with spontaneous sweating and dizziness, one should use Single Ginseng Decoction (獨參湯). If there is vexation and agitation with sleeplessness, one should use Modified Spleen-Returning Decoction (加味歸脾湯). If there is vexation and agitation with hypochondriac pain, one should use Bupleurum Four Substances Decoction (柴胡四物湯). If there is vexation and agitation from excessive loss of blood, one should use Sage Healing Decoction (聖愈湯). <ins>Modified Spleen-Returning Decoction (加味歸脾湯)</ins> (the formula is found under oppression and pain of the chest and abdomen, 胸腹痛悶)
<ins>Dang Gui Blood-Supplementing Decoction (當歸補血湯)</ins> and <ins>Sage Healing Decoction (聖愈湯)</ins> (both are found under fever, 發熱)
<ins>Bupleurum Four Substances Decoction (柴胡四物湯)</ins> (this is the Four Substances Decoction (四物湯) with added bupleurum (柴胡) and scutellaria (黃芩). The formula is found under injury with bleeding, 傷損出血.
